description: This is a PHP class file for the LeaveRequestDao class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements data access methods for handling leave requests, leaves, entitlements, statuses, and related entities, including persisting, updating, retrieving, and querying leave-related data, with transaction management and complex filtering capabilities.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDao
classes.description: Data Access Object (DAO) for managing leave request data within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and querying leave requests and associated entities with complex filtering and transaction management.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists a leave request along with linked leaves and entitlement adjustments within a database transaction, updating leave entitlements and handling potential exceptions.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Saves or updates a leave request comment entity, setting creation timestamp if needed.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Persists a leave entity.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a leave, optionally removing entitlement links, updating entitlement usage, and managing database transaction safety.

methods.name: getOverlappingLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leave records that overlap with specified date and time ranges for a given employee, considering partial day overlaps and multiple overlapping scenarios.

methods.name: getTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Calculates the total hours of leave taken by an employee on a specific date, considering only non-rejected or canceled leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Fetches a leave record based on its unique ID.

methods.name: markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Triggers internal method to update status of approved leaves to 'taken' based on current date.

methods.name: _markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Internal method that updates leaves marked as approved to 'taken' if their date has passed.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRangeQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates a query builder for fetching leave requests for an employee within an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Returns leave requests for an employee filtered by an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeavesByEmpNumberAndDates
methods.description: Retrieves leaves for an employee on specific dates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequests
methods.description: Returns leave requests based on complex search filter parameters, including status, date range, employee, leave type, and subunit filters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns count of leave requests matching specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for leave request queries, applying sorting, filtering, and pagination based on given parameters.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Retrieves leaves associated with specific leave request IDs.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatuses
methods.description: Returns all leave status entities from the database.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a leave request entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns all leaves associated with a specific leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves based on given filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Returns count of leaves matching the given filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Fetches leave requests corresponding to provided IDs.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveIds
methods.description: Fetches leave records for specific leave IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaves
methods.description: Returns employee's leave records filtered by parameters, including date range and pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesCount
methods.description: Returns count of employee leaves under given filter parameters.

methods.name: getUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves distinct leave type IDs used by an employee within an optional date range.
